generatedFrom: ProductNow backend MCP source and tools/list public metadata

tools.description: Change the status of the document associated with a document version. Valid status values: ON_TRACK, AT_RISK, OFF_TRACK, COMPLETED. Use list_document_versions or search_documents to find the document version ID first.
tools.name: change_document_version_status
tools.title: Change Document Version Status

tools.description: Create a new ProductNow document and immediately begin AI generation. Use prompt for the short generation brief. Use context for any additional background, such as the full text of a plan file or notes from a prior conversation. If the user references a file by name, read that file first and pass its contents as context. If the user specifies a template by name, call search_templates first to get the templateVersionId, then pass it here.
tools.name: create_document
tools.title: Create Document

tools.description: Leave a comment on a document that is in review status. The comment is posted as the user's personal agent. Only works on review-status document versions. Use list_document_versions to find the correct documentVersionId first.
tools.name: create_document_comment
tools.title: Create Document Comment

tools.description: Create a new folder in ProductNow. Optionally nest it inside a parent folder. Returns the new folder's ID and name.
tools.name: create_folder
tools.title: Create Folder

tools.description: Create a new blank ProductNow help document. Only available to ProductNow users. Returns the document ID, help page publication ID, and a URL to the document editor where content can be added.
tools.name: create_help_document
tools.title: Create Help Document

tools.description: Create a brand new template in ProductNow. Returns the new template's ID, name, and metadata.
tools.name: create_template
tools.title: Create Template

tools.description: Add a note to a template version in ProductNow. Notes are used to track observations, feedback, or context about a template. Returns the new note's ID on success.
tools.name: create_template_note
tools.title: Create Template Note

tools.description: Add a new section to a template version in ProductNow. Each section has a title, instructions for the AI when generating that section, an optional display order, and an optional content type. Returns the new section's ID on success.
tools.name: create_template_section
tools.title: Create Template Section

tools.description: Permanently delete a template. This action cannot be undone. Requires MANAGE permission on the template.
tools.name: delete_template
tools.title: Delete Template

tools.description: Delete a section from a template version. This action cannot be undone. Requires EDIT permission on the parent template.
tools.name: delete_template_section
tools.title: Delete Template Section

tools.description: Edit a template's name. Omit name to leave it unchanged.
tools.name: edit_template
tools.title: Edit Template

tools.description: Edit an existing section within a template version in ProductNow. All fields are optional; only the fields provided will be updated. At least one field must be supplied. Returns the section's ID on success. Note that if edit_template_version was just used, section IDs will have changed.
tools.name: edit_template_section
tools.title: Edit Template Section

tools.description: Replace the content of a template version by providing a new .templatepn JSON. First use get_template_content to retrieve the current content, modify it, then pass the updated JSON here. The templateId in the JSON must match the templateId argument.
tools.name: edit_template_version
tools.title: Edit Template Version

tools.description: Edit a template version's metadata, including description, creation guidelines, category, default length, and default effort. Include only the fields to change.
tools.name: edit_template_version_metadata
tools.title: Edit Template Version Metadata

tools.description: Retrieve a document attachment as a base64-encoded file with its MIME type and file name. Use this to read image or file attachments referenced in a document. Requires VIEW access to the document the attachment belongs to.
tools.name: get_attachment
tools.title: Get Attachment

tools.description: Retrieve the full content of a ProductNow document by its ID, optionally targeting a specific version via documentVersionId. Returns the document name, version ID and status, folder location, and all section content. Use search_documents first to find the document ID.
tools.name: get_document
tools.title: Get Document

tools.description: Fetch the current chat messages and edit mode for a document's AI draft chat. Returns the conversation history and whether the agent is in ask_before_edit or edit_automatically mode.
tools.name: get_document_chat
tools.title: Get Document Chat

tools.description: Retrieve all feedback submitted on the latest review version of a document, returned as CSV. Columns include ID, Title, Description, Feedback, Feedback Type, and Created On. Use search_documents to find the document ID.
tools.name: get_document_feedback
tools.title: Get Document Feedback

tools.description: Fetch all comment threads on a specific document version. Returns thread IDs, statuses, quoted text, and creation timestamps. Use get_thread_messages to read the messages within a specific thread.
tools.name: get_document_threads
tools.title: Get Document Threads

tools.description: Retrieve the current status of the document associated with a document version. Returns the status value (ON_TRACK, AT_RISK, OFF_TRACK, COMPLETED), dates, and active flag. Use list_document_versions or search_documents to find the document version ID first.
tools.name: get_document_version_status
tools.title: Get Document Version Status

tools.description: Fetch the current chat messages and edit mode for a template's AI chat. Returns the conversation history and whether the agent is in ask_before_edit or edit_automatically mode.
tools.name: get_template_chat
tools.title: Get Template Chat

tools.description: Get the full content of a template's latest version in .templatepn format. Returns a JSON string containing the template structure with all sections, instructions, and metadata. Use this to inspect a template before editing it.
tools.name: get_template_content
tools.title: Get Template Content

tools.description: Fetch all messages in a specific comment thread. Returns message IDs, content, author names, timestamps, and whether each message was posted by an AI agent. Use get_document_threads to find thread IDs first.
tools.name: get_thread_messages
tools.title: Get Thread Messages

tools.description: Import a prototype from a published URL or from inline HTML, JSX, or TSX file content. URL imports must use HTTPS and an allowlisted prototyping host. Returns the hosted S3 URL and an iframe HTML snippet that can be embedded in a prototype element.
tools.name: import_prototype
tools.title: Import Prototype

tools.description: List all versions of a document, optionally filtered by status (draft, review, or published). Returns version IDs, version numbers, statuses, and creation timestamps. Useful for locating a specific review or published version before fetching threads or commenting.
tools.name: list_document_versions
tools.title: List Document Versions

tools.description: List folders accessible to the current user, optionally filtered to a specific parent folder. Omit parentFolderId to list root-level folders. Use this to navigate the folder hierarchy before creating documents or folders.
tools.name: list_folders
tools.title: List Folders

tools.description: List ProductNow help documents accessible to the calling user. Optionally filter by category. Use get_document to read the full content of a specific help document.
tools.name: list_help_documents
tools.title: List Help Documents

tools.description: List all templates the user has access to. Optionally filter by access level (edit vs view) or by category. Returns template IDs, names, descriptions, categories, and whether the user can edit each template.
tools.name: list_templates
tools.title: List Templates

tools.description: Post a message to a document's AI draft chat to request edits or ask questions about the document. The message is sent to the draft agent, which can modify the document's content. Use this to request changes to a document via natural language.
tools.name: post_document_chat_message
tools.title: Post Document Chat Message

tools.description: Post a message to a template's AI chat to request edits or ask questions about the template. The message is sent to the template agent, which can modify the template's sections and instructions. Use this to request changes to a template via natural language.
tools.name: post_template_chat_message
tools.title: Post Template Chat Message

tools.description: Add an emoji reaction to a specific comment thread message. Requires COMMENT permission on the document. Use get_thread_messages to find message IDs.
tools.name: react_to_message
tools.title: React To Message

tools.description: Reply to an existing comment thread on a document as the user's personal agent. Requires COMMENT permission on the document. Use get_document_threads to find thread IDs.
tools.name: reply_to_thread
tools.title: Reply To Thread

tools.description: Search for ProductNow documents by name. Returns a list of matching documents with their IDs and folder paths. Use this to find a document before calling get_document to read its content.
tools.name: search_documents
tools.title: Search Documents

tools.description: Search for ProductNow help documents by name. Returns a list of matching help documents with their IDs and folder paths. Use this to find a help document before calling get_document to read its content.
tools.name: search_help_documents
tools.title: Search Help Documents

tools.description: Search for ProductNow templates by name. Call this before create_document when the user specifies a template by name. Returns matches with templateVersionId values; pick the best match and pass its templateVersionId to create_document.
tools.name: search_templates
tools.title: Search Templates

tools.description: Switch the edit mode of a document's AI draft chat. ask_before_edit means the agent asks for confirmation before making changes; edit_automatically means the agent applies edits directly without asking. Set to edit_automatically for faster iterative edits.
tools.name: switch_document_chat_edit_mode
tools.title: Switch Document Chat Edit Mode

tools.description: Switch the edit mode of a template's AI chat. ask_before_edit means the agent asks for confirmation before making changes; edit_automatically means the agent applies edits directly without asking. Set to edit_automatically for faster iterative edits.
tools.name: switch_template_edit_mode
tools.title: Switch Template Edit Mode

tools.description: Upload a media file (image or video) to ProductNow storage. Returns a signed backend uploadUrl valid for 5 minutes, plus a url and htmlText that can be embedded in documents immediately. Allowed MIME types include PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, MP4, WebM, and QuickTime.
tools.name: upload_media
tools.title: Upload Media
